quotes.text: And yes, you can interrupt mid meeting with a prompt like what are the key decisions so far and get an answer before the call even ends. The distinction is critical. Copilot is not a stenographer, it's an active interpreter.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concisely reframes Copilot in meetings as an active interpreter rather than a note taker.

quotes.text: In fact, you won't get the useful recap unless transcription is on in the first place. No transcript, no copilot memory
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States a practical prerequisite that users often miss.

quotes.text: Each claim links back to the original message. That's not a summary, that's a decision log you can validate instantly.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Highlights citations as what makes chat summaries trustworthy.

quotes.text: It's bound by Microsoft Graph and semantic indexing. That means it only surfaces content you already have permission to access, and it does so with contextual awareness.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains clearly how Copilot Chat respects existing permissions.

quotes.text: When properly governed, Copilot becomes labor reallocation technology. Without governance, it's a glitchy luxury toy, the economics hinge entirely on administrative hygiene.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable verdict tying Copilot's ROI to governance.

Governance limits and licensing reality check
Wrap-up: a control room, not a notepad

takeaways: Copilot in Teams turns meetings into structured, cited records of decisions and action items, but only when transcription is enabled.
Copilot Chat uses Microsoft Graph and semantic indexing to answer across chats, mail, files and meetings while respecting existing permissions.
Agents built in Copilot Studio, admin policies, Purview, SharePoint Advanced Management and licensing decide what Copilot can actually do in your tenant.
hook: Still treating Copilot in Teams as a sidebar that writes summaries? This episode is for Microsoft 365 admins and knowledge workers who drown in meetings and chats. Learn how meeting recaps, cited chat digests, Copilot Chat and agents work together, and which governance and licensing settings decide whether any of it shows up.
